title.en: The One With the Stolen Trucks

description.es: La empresa sufre el asalto de dos camiones con mercancía valiosa, generando sospechas de complicidad interna y caos entre los accionistas. Marta agradece el apoyo de Cloe durante la gestión del robo, aunque Cloe, al verla consumida por los problemas de la empresa, decide guardar silencio sobre la información que tiene acerca de Fina.
description.en: The company suffers the robbery of two trucks carrying valuable merchandise, raising suspicions of an inside job and causing chaos among the shareholders. Marta is grateful for Cloe's support while dealing with the robbery, though Cloe, seeing her consumed by the company's problems, decides to keep quiet about the information she has regarding Fina.
